errors.text_span: The categories are represented on the horizontal axis
errors.evidence: The categories (Understanding, Reasoning, Trustworthiness) are the titles of the three separate subplots. The horizontal axis in each subplot represents the percentage score, not the categories.
The model names on the vertical axis are not ordered alphabetically. They are sorted in descending order based on their performance in the 'Understanding' category.
While the 'Understanding' and 'Trustworthiness' plots have tick labels at 20% intervals, the 'Reasoning' plot has them at 10% intervals.
The minimum value in the 'Reasoning' category is 6.8% for 'Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct', not 7.2%.

errors.text_span: The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each category
errors.evidence: The models are sorted based on their scores in the 'Understanding' chart, from highest to lowest. This order is maintained for the other two charts.
In the 'Reasoning' category, the shortest bar belongs to 'Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct' with a value of 6.8%, not 'Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407' with a value of 7.2%.

The chart visually emphasizes several models (the 'gpt' models) by coloring their bars bright blue, in contrast to the steel-blue color of the other bars. The description incorrectly states there is no emphasis.
